description: Shares outstanding and cash over time for one company, from its SEC XBRL filings, with the offerings and cash events from its dilution snapshot so each raise can be lined up against the share count and cash around it. Response fields: `sharesOutstanding[]` and `cash[]` (SEC filing data, returned for any company with SEC filings); `fullyDiluted`, `cashEstimate`, `offerings[]` and `cashEvents[]` (from the dilution snapshot, null when the company has not been analysed yet, in which case `offeringMarkers` is "not-covered"); `coverage` (`available`, `unavailableReason`, `status`); and the withheld-row fields. `degraded: true` means an SEC request failed and the series may be incomplete. Each `sharesOutstanding` point is the count as filed, on the split basis in force when it was reported and not rebased to today, so a reverse split shows as a step and a growth rate measured across a split is not meaningful. `fullyDiluted` is on the current split basis. A gap in the series means no filing covered that period, not that the count was unchanged. Returns HTTP 200 when the snapshot is unavailable (read `coverage`); 404 only when the ticker maps to no SEC filer. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_dilution_history
title: Get Shares-Outstanding and Cash History
